stories.title: Twee mannen veroordeeld voor ernstige mishandeling dorpsgenoot die vóór asielopvang pleitte

en.title: Two men convicted of serious assault on village resident who advocated for asylum reception
en.summary: Two men have been convicted of severely assaulting a fellow villager who had spoken in favor of asylum housing facilities.

stories.title: Zeker 75 katten gevonden in Frans appartement, ook dode kittens in de vriezer

en.title: At least 75 cats found in French apartment, dead kittens also discovered in freezer
en.summary: Over 75 cats were discovered in a Paris apartment, with dead kittens found in the freezer. An animal welfare organization has filed charges of animal cruelty.

stories.title: De politie organiseert niet langer iftars, want die kunnen ‘verwarring’ scheppen over haar ‘neutrale positie’

en.title: Police no longer organize iftars, as these could create 'confusion' about their 'neutral position'
en.summary: Dutch police leadership has discontinued organizing iftar meals following criticism from The Hague about potential concerns regarding institutional neutrality. Officers involved expressed confusion over the sudden policy reversal.

stories.title: 75 katten gevonden in klein appartement in Parijs, dode kittens in vriezer

en.title: 75 cats found in small apartment in Paris, dead kittens in freezer
en.summary: An animal welfare organization rescued 75 cats from a small Paris apartment where they lived in deplorable conditions after the tenant's eviction. Dead kittens were discovered in the freezer and neighbors had complained previously.

stories.title: Bijna 500 arrestaties, 803 dieren en veel drugs onderschept bij grote politieactie

en.title: Nearly 500 arrests, 803 animals and large drug haul intercepted in major police operation
en.summary: An international police operation led by Belgian authorities resulted in 490 arrests across 34 countries. Officers seized 803 animals and over 150 tons of drugs during the coordinated action.

stories.title: Overheid komt met nieuwe subsidie elektrisch rijden voor lage inkomens

en.title: Government introduces new subsidy for electric vehicles for low-income households
en.summary: The government announced a new subsidy program to support electric vehicle purchases among low-income residents.

stories.title: Cel- en taakstraf voor tegenstanders azc Engelen die vrouw mishandelden

en.title: Prison and community service for asylum center opponents who assaulted woman
en.summary: Two men were convicted of assaulting a woman they believed had interfered with protests against an asylum center. One received 36 days imprisonment plus conditional sentence and community service, while the other received community service hours and a behavioral course.

stories.title: Nederlandse vader die zoon (14) in België liet sterven veroordeeld tot 23 jaar cel

en.title: Dutch father sentenced to 23 years for refusing medical care to his son (14) who died in Belgium
en.summary: A court in Antwerp sentenced a man to 23 years imprisonment for failing to seek medical help for his 14-year-old son suffering from COVID-19 in late 2021. The boy died in January 2022, and his body was discovered eight weeks later.

stories.title: Amerikaanse media stappen naar de rechter nadat Trump hen de toegang tot het Witte Huis ontnam

en.title: American media take Trump to court after he denied them access to the White House
en.summary: CNN, MS Now, and Politico sued President Trump after being denied White House access, asking a court to reverse the decision. Other major U.S. media outlets expressed solidarity and withdrew from the television pool.

stories.title: Nederlandse vader krijgt 23 jaar cel in België voor moord na verwaarlozing zoon

en.title: Dutch father receives 23-year sentence in Belgium for murder following son's neglect
en.summary: A Dutch man was sentenced to 23 years in prison by a court in Antwerp for killing his 14-year-old son in 2022. The victim was discovered eight weeks later with ketamine in his system.

stories.title: Grote Amerikaanse omroepen tonen zich solidair met uit het Witte Huis verbannen media

en.title: Major American broadcasters show solidarity with media banned from the White House
en.summary: Major American media outlets expressed support for news organizations that were denied access to the White House.

stories.title: Taakstraf voor mannen die vrouw mishandelden rond onrust asielopvang Engelen

en.title: Community service for men who assaulted woman during unrest over asylum shelter in Engelen
en.summary: A district court in Den Bosch sentenced two men, aged 41 and 43, to community service for assaulting a woman. The men claimed the victim had sabotaged protests against an asylum facility opening in Engelen.
